Many countries that became independent after World War II found that the legacy of colonialism hindered their economic development. The list of hindrances included
Option A: artificial political boundaries that covered diverse ethnic groups with little in common
Option B: inadequate access to higher education and training for nationals under the colonial administration
Option C: control of domestic commerce by foreign minority groups which had been brought in by the colonial power
Option D: all of the above
